company.name: Credgenics
company.shortDescription: Credgenics is a tech-enabled platform that specializes in debt recovery and legal automation.
company.description: Credgenics is an NPA resolution platform backed by investors including Accel Partners and Titan Capital. The company works with financial institutions, Banks, NBFCs, and Digital lending firms to improve collections efficiency using technology, automation intelligence, and optimal legal routes in order to facilitate the resolution of stressed assets.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform that manages loan collections and debt resolution across digital, calling, field, payment, and legal workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Credgenics Full-Stack Debt Collections Platform

productsAndServices.description: A digital-first collections solution for automating borrower outreach, repayment requests, workflows, and recovery strategies across the loan lifecycle.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Debt Collections

productsAndServices.description: An analytics solution that uses machine learning to segment borrowers, predict payment behavior, optimize outreach, and monitor collections performance.
productsAndServices.name: Collections Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A multichannel borrower communication service supporting personalized outreach through SMS, WhatsApp, email, IVR, voicebots, and chatbots.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Communications

productsAndServices.description: A generative AI voicebot for borrower conversations, intent and sentiment identification, payment-link sharing, and collections follow-ups.
productsAndServices.name: Swara NextGen AI Assistant

productsAndServices.description: A mobile application for digitizing field collections through case allocation, visit scheduling, location tracking, payment recording, and receipt generation.
productsAndServices.name: CG Collect Field App
